However, relying on past multi-year compounding masks a severe 1-year collapse of -12% [E13] and an extreme valuation disconnect where a 611x P/E and 499.1x EV/EBITDA [E4, E9] are paired with an essentially non-existent ROE of 0.12% and ROCE of 0.15% [E7, E8].
